profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer at , Xcode. Maya developer back in the Alias | Wavefront days. Ventura, CA, USA. He/Him. Page House ’93 (Spe Labor Levis)

positions.title: Independent Software Developer
positions.description: Design and build apps across Apple platforms using Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, AppKit, and watchOS. Leverage a wide range of Apple frameworks including Swift Concurrency, Combine, WidgetKit, App Intents, ARKit, RealityKit, SceneKit, Core ML, Core Motion, and Vision to create responsive, high-performance applications. Experience with 3D graphics programming using Vulkan and Metal. Projects range from solo prototyping to production-ready releases.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Augmented Reality (AR) · Objective-C · SwiftUI · Swift (Programming Language) · CloudKit · Xcode · Core Data · iOS · UIKit · iOS Development · iPhone Application Development · Python (Programming Language) · iOS Design

positions.title: Organizational Consultant
positions.description: Guided churches and nonprofit leaders through strategic refocus as a certified Auxano navigator. Trained teams to replicate planning processes locally and advised on structural changes and rollout strategies.
positions.insights: Skills: Change Management · Strategy · Teamwork · Leadership Development Coaching · Organizational Development · Executive Coaching

positions.title: Assistant District Supervisor
positions.description:
Partnered with the District Supervisor to lead and support 150 churches and nonprofits across Southern California. Oversaw organizational transitions, leadership coaching, and strategic alignment. Managed a central team of 6–10 direct reports and directly led 10 organizations with 5–15 staff each.

•	Delivered weekly public speaking engagements to audiences of 40–300+.
•	Led conflict resolution between church members, leaders, and boards.
•	Built internal systems to track organizational activity, training, and events
•	Developed automation solutions and custom Python apps using REST APIs.
•	Stepped in as interim leader for struggling organizations to stabilize operations.
•	Designed evaluation frameworks for churches in transition, covering GAAP, IRS compliance, leases, and organizational health.
•	Mentored emerging leaders and trained teams in leadership and growth strategies.
•	Oversaw all aspects of departmental finance, including budgeting, account management, compliance, and reporting.
•	Consulted on long-range planning systems for 5–20 year organizational goals.

positions.title: Lead Pastor
positions.description:
Led a local church through a season of growth and community engagement. Managed a team of 10 direct reports overseeing various operational areas. Focused on team development, strategic planning, and local outreach.

•	Built and trained a leadership team to manage all aspects of church operations.
•	Launched a neighborhood food bank to serve the surrounding community.
•	Oversaw weekly services, teaching, and community-building efforts.

positions.title: District Administrator/Executive Pastor/Youth Pastor
positions.description:
Supported a network of churches with operations, leadership development, and youth programs. Advised on property acquisitions, lease negotiations, leadership transitions, and credentialing.

•	Led regional programs serving thousands of students across multiple events.
•	Coordinated credentialing processes and compliance for pastoral staff.
•	Acted as a liaison between local churches and district leadership on operational and legal matters.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributor to the development of Maya, from its initial release through version 5.5. Worked in C++ on feature design, core animation tools, and device integration, collaborating with teams of 100–150 engineers worldwide.

•	Specialized in motion capture integration and virtual device development to streamline raw data input into Maya’s animation system.
•	Improved stability and performance of device code used in character animation pipelines.
•	Added file referencing and namespace support in Maya’s file format system.
•	Contributed to FK/IK tools, animation curves, and the non-linear animation system.
•	Worked on the Maya API to add custom engineering features based on customer input and feedback.
•	Acted as primary development contact for a major film studio, customizing Maya and its API to fit production needs while balancing company priorities and maintaining NDAs.
positions.insights: Skills: Teamwork · Software Development · 3D Graphics · C++ · Maya · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed real-time graphics systems and motion capture pipelines for interactive characters and live animation performances. Focused on performance animation tools, hardware calibration, and custom C/C++ development on SGI workstations running Irix.

•	Adapted and implemented a specialized version of GL for Panasonic’s 3DO gaming platform.
•	Enhanced the VActor live animation system for character tuning and stage performance.
•	Built custom tools to address challenges of magnetic motion capture in live environments.
•	Calibrated and tested systems using mechanical waldos, Polhemus trackers, and Adaptive Optics facial and body capture rigs.
•	Led motion capture sessions for video game production, including scripting, calibration, quality control, and talent coordination.
positions.insights: Skills: Teamwork · C · Software Development · 3D Graphics · C++ · Motion Capture
